name: Singapore Grand Prix
sources_2026_10_11: Race-story notes and results verified against the FIA final race classification, final sprint classification, final qualifying classification and final starting grid, plus the Formula 1 race, sprint, qualifying and fastest-lap result pages, all dated 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-11. Full race reports read from Formula1.com and the FIA. DNF causes cross-checked against Formula 1 driver/team reports and the FIA race report. No classification-position disagreement was found between the final FIA and Formula 1 classifications. Data notes: sprint rows carry no grid/qualifying/fastLap sub-objects, matching the sprint block shape in r12-zandvoort.json.
summary: Max Verstappen converted pole into his first Singapore Grand Prix win, leading all 62 laps and beating Charles Leclerc by 7.335s; Kimi Antonelli completed the podium. Two Virtual Safety Cars interrupted the race, first for Gabriel Bortoleto's gearbox failure and fire at the pit exit and then for Lance Stroll's clutch failure; there was no Safety Car and no red flag. Leclerc's second stop and Lewis Hamilton's decision to stay out under the late VSC reshaped the podium fight, while George Russell recovered from P19 to P9 and Isack Hadjar reached P10 from the pit lane. Four drivers failed to finish: Albon was classified P18 after fuel and brake problems, while Stroll, Colapinto and Bortoleto were unclassified. Verstappen also won Saturday's rain-hit Sprint, where Russell crashed out of the lead on lap one and the McLaren team-mates collided late on.
